$comment: FICTIONAL workshop data. Invented wards and invented scores for a made-up hospital, used to demonstrate an agent calling into a local system of record. Nothing here describes a real facility, and nothing here is clinical guidance. The eight components are the real core components named in the WHO IPC guideline; the scores against them are not.

scale.meaning: Internal self-assessment maturity score. 0 = not in place, 5 = fully implemented and audited.
scale.source: Internal quality team, not a WHO instrument.

components.ipc_programme: IPC programme with a dedicated, trained team
components.ipc_guidelines: Evidence-based IPC guidelines adapted to the facility
components.education_and_training: IPC education and training for health workers
components.multimodal_strategies: Multimodal strategies for implementing IPC activities
components.monitoring_audit_feedback: Monitoring and auditing of IPC practices with feedback
components.workload_staffing_bed_occupancy: Appropriate workload, staffing levels and bed occupancy
components.built_environment_wash: Built environment, materials and equipment, including WASH services

derived_from.$comment: Only the eight component NAMES are derived from the WHO source below. The ward names and every score in this file are invented and are not WHO content.
derived_from.title: Guidelines on core components of infection prevention and control programmes at the national and acute health care facility level
derived_from.citation: Guidelines on core components of infection prevention and control programmes at the national and acute health care facility level. Geneva: World Health Organization; 2016. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO.
derived_from.disclaimer: This is an adaptation of an original work by the World Health Organization (WHO). Views and opinions expressed in the adaptation are the sole responsibility of the author or authors of the adaptation and are not endorsed by WHO.

wards.name: General Medicine
wards.notes: Bed occupancy has exceeded 100% on 41 days this year. Audit programme paused since March.

wards.name: Surgical
wards.notes: Strongest performer. Runs a monthly audit-and-feedback cycle.

wards.name: Intensive Care
wards.notes: High agency-staff turnover; induction training backlog of 19 staff.
